thread:
marta.k: Quick kickoff  idea: a tiny "credit sprint" for new signups this week. Goal: measure how fast users run a first prompt when given a small time-limited boost.

nate.r: Love the urgency angle. What boost?

marta.k: 40 credits good for 72h. Short landing, single CTA, preloaded prompt pack (3). Hypothesis: time-limited credits increase time-to-first-run and prompt-save rates.

sophie.p: We should A/B test messaging: FOMO ("limited-time") vs helpful ("starter boost"). Two cohorts, 50/50. Primary metric = 24h_prompt_run_rate.

ops-bot: Ops checklist: add utm_campaign=credit_sprint, LD flag credit_sprint_v1, hubspot.lead_source=credit_sprint. Will add user property credits_expires_at. ETA EOD.

growth-bot: Reminder: include eval on starter prompts and events: claim_credit, prompt_run, prompt_save. Also capture campaign_cohort prop.

nate.r: Copy drafts:
- FOMO: "Limited 40 credits  try our starter prompts"
- Helpful: "A 40-credit starter boost to ship your first prompt"

marta.k: Nice. Landing must show countdown and clear expiry. Also include a tiny survey on unlock toast: "What did you try? [copy|code|reply]". Owners: Sophie (copy + cohorts), Nate (creative + GIF), Ops-bot (flags + hubspot), Marta (experiment lead).

sophie.p: Timeline: mockup today, soft internal Thursday AM, public Friday 11am PT. Daily dashboard first 48h.

marta.k: Thanks all 680. Quick sync 9:30am tomorrow to confirm assets.
